theme: UI state with concurrency: loading state, MainActor view model and MainActor.run

terms.definition: A value, often an enum, that says whether a screen is idle, loading or done.
terms.example: Add a loading state so the spinner shows.
terms.code:
enum LoadState { case idle, loading, done }
var state = LoadState.idle
state = .loading
print(state)

terms.definition: An observable class marked @MainActor, so every change to its screen state happens on the main actor.
terms.example: Make the MainActor view model own the screen state.

terms.definition: A static method that runs a closure on the main actor and gives back its result.
terms.example: Use MainActor.run to hop back for one update.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to talk about keeping screen state on the main actor while async work runs elsewhere: Loading State, MainActor View Model & MainActor.run, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Loading State - A value, often an enum, that says whether a screen is idle, loading or done.
MainActor View Model - An observable class marked @MainActor, so every change to its screen state happens on the main actor.
MainActor.run - A static method that runs a closure on the main actor and gives back its result.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Loading State, MainActor View Model & MainActor.run in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Loading State, MainActor View Model, MainActor.run 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Loading State - A value, often an enum, that says whether a screen is idle, loading or done.
한국어: Loading State: 화면이 대기, 로딩 중, 완료 중 어느 상태인지 나타내는 값(주로 enum)

MainActor View Model - An observable class marked @MainActor, so every change to its screen state happens on the main actor.
한국어: MainActor View Model: @MainActor가 붙은 관찰 가능한 클래스로, 화면 상태 변경이 모두 메인 액터에서 일어남

MainActor.run - A static method that runs a closure on the main actor and gives back its result.
한국어: MainActor.run: 클로저를 메인 액터에서 실행하고 그 결과를 돌려주는 정적 메서드

landscape.hook: Can you explain Loading State, MainActor View Model and MainActor.run in English?

dialogue.title: Update the screen from async code

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my screen sometimes shows the old title after a refresh.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where do you change `title`? It must change on the main actor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Inside an async method of my view model. It has no `@MainActor` yet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make it a MainActor view model. Then every change to its state happens on the main actor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I also need a loading state?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A loading state says if the screen is idle, loading or done. An enum works well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: OK. And what if a background task needs to update one label?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use MainActor.run. It runs a closure on the main actor and returns its result.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. If the class is a MainActor view model, you rarely need it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Loading state, MainActor view model, and MainActor.run only for edge cases.
